world.title: Lula holds off far right with victory in Brazil presidential election
world.summary: Leftist President Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva has won Brazil's presidential election, defeating right-wing Senator Flavio Bolsonaro. Lula's victory comes after an unexpected first-round loss that energized Bolsonaro's supporters. The election highlighted Brazil's deep political divisions and marked a significant comeback for Lula, who previously served as president from 2003 to 2010, amid a contentious political landscape.

world.title: ‘The people have won’: Serbia’s Vucic concedes defeat after student-led protests win elections
world.summary: Serbia's Prime Minister Aleksandar Vucic conceded defeat following parliamentary elections influenced by student-led protests. Tens of thousands celebrated in the capital, marking a significant political shift. The electoral list "Student List - Students Win" emerged victorious, reflecting widespread public discontent with Vucic's long-standing leadership. The protests and subsequent election results signal a potential change in Serbia's political landscape.

world.title: Trump calls El-Sayed ‘jihadist’, accuses him of backing Sharia law and alleges mother’s Al-Qaeda links
world.summary: US President Donald Trump criticized Democratic Senate candidate Abdul El-Sayed in a Truth Social post before a rally in Port Huron, Michigan. Trump labeled El-Sayed a "jihadist," accused him of supporting Sharia law, and claimed his mother had links to Al-Qaeda. The remarks come as Trump seeks to influence the upcoming midterm elections in Michigan.

business.title: Stock Market Today: All You Need To Know Going Into Trade On Oct 26
business.summary: On October 26, the Gift Nifty was trading at approximately 22,609.50, reflecting a premium of 35.90 points over the previous Nifty futures close, suggesting a positive opening for the Nifty 50. The NSE Nifty 50 and BSE Sensex experienced declines of 0.39% and 0.17%, respectively, indicating mixed market sentiments ahead of the trading session.

business.title: Stocks in news: Infosys, Kotak Mahindra Bank, YES Bank, Raymond, BPCL, Coforge and Senco Gold
business.summary: Indian equity markets declined for the fourth consecutive session, with the Nifty dropping 2.36% to close at 22,600. Factors contributing to this downturn include persistent selling by foreign investors and rising crude oil prices. Stocks like Infosys and Kotak Mahindra Bank drew investor attention due to their quarterly earnings, while upcoming developments may further influence market sentiment.

business.title: BlackRock stays cautious on Indian equities despite cheaper valuations
business.summary: BlackRock Investment Institute remains cautious on Indian equities, citing ongoing uncertainties. The firm seeks clarity on corporate earnings and energy prices before altering its outlook. Despite high energy costs, India's economic resilience is notable amid geopolitical tensions. Foreign investors have been net sellers of Indian equities for several months, affecting overall market performance and investor sentiment.

technology.title: AMAZON RELEASES NEW TOMB RAIDER LEGACY OF ATLANTIS TEASER TRAILER
technology.summary: Amazon Game Studios has unveiled a teaser trailer for the upcoming game, Tomb Raider Legacy of Atlantis, featuring Lara Croft. Portions of the footage were previously presented at MCM London and Tomb Raider Derby events. The release of the trailer coincides with the 30th anniversary of the Tomb Raider series, celebrating its long-standing legacy in gaming.

technology.title: Samsung Galaxy Z Fold 8 vs iPhone Duo: Foldable Phone Showdown
technology.summary: Samsung has launched the Galaxy Z Fold 8, marking its continued dominance in the foldable smartphone market. Meanwhile, Apple has entered the arena with the iPhone Duo. Both devices boast large displays and advanced features, aiming to compete effectively in 2026's evolving landscape. The comparison focuses on performance, value, and unique offerings of each smartphone.

technology.title: Early iPhone Duo buyers report inner display damage caused by a potential hinge defect
technology.summary: Multiple buyers of Apple's first foldable device, the iPhone Duo, have reported similar inner display damage. The damage manifests as vertical and horizontal lines, suggesting a potential defect related to the device's hinge. These reports have surfaced online, indicating a concerning trend among early adopters. Apple has yet to officially respond to these claims regarding the iPhone Duo's durability.

sports.title: Lewis Hamilton reveals the mistake that cost him a podium at the US Grand Prix
sports.summary: Lewis Hamilton attributed his fourth-place finish at the US Grand Prix to a set-up mistake that caused significant understeer in his Ferrari. He stated that the issue prevented him from effectively turning the car during the race. Despite being a seven-time world champion, Hamilton faced challenges at Circuit of the Americas, ultimately missing out on a podium position.

sports.title: From outranking the Fab Four to fight for his place: Rise, reign and the unraveling of Marnus Labuschagne
sports.summary: Marnus Labuschagne's performance has declined significantly, leading to criticism from commentators, including Simon Katich, during the second Test against South Africa. Once considered a top player, Labuschagne's recent struggles have raised questions about his position in the team. Australia faced challenges, being forced to follow on, highlighting the pressure on Labuschagne to regain his form and secure his place.

sports.title: A strategic masterclass: How Antonelli put himself on the cusp of F1 title at the US GP
sports.summary: Kimi Antonelli secured a crucial victory at the United States Grand Prix, moving him within two points of the 2026 Formula 1 title. Starting from pole, he effectively managed a one-stop strategy to outperform competitors Max Verstappen and Charles Leclerc. The championship could be decided next weekend in Mexico City, as Antonelli approaches the title.

health.title: Mass General Brigham develops AI predicting cancer survival from photos
health.summary: Researchers at Mass General Brigham Cancer Institute have created an AI tool that predicts cancer treatment survival chances using a single facial photograph. The AI was trained on over 42 million images, enabling it to assess how patients may respond to treatments such as surgery or radiation. This innovation aims to enhance personalized cancer care and improve patient outcomes.

health.title: I had no idea I had an increased risk of developing osteoporosis until I tried this free quiz-here’s how to check your bone health
health.summary: Osteoporosis is a chronic, age-related condition characterized by a gradual decline in bone mineral density and mass, leading to weak and brittle bones. Often referred to as a silent disease, it typically presents no pain or obvious symptoms. A free three-minute quiz is available to help individuals assess their risk for developing osteoporosis and check their bone health.

health.title: Melioidosis in India: a potentially deadly infection that may be going undetected
health.summary: Melioidosis, a potentially fatal infection, is underdiagnosed in India, particularly among high-risk adults. A case involving a 48-year-old man with uncontrolled diabetes highlights the need for improved awareness and diagnostics. Initial misidentification of the infection underscores the challenges in detection. Experts are calling for enhanced surveillance and better diagnostic methods to address this public health concern effectively.

science.title: Retired Brookhaven Collider Delivers a Final Surprise as Oxygen Collisions Show Jets Losing Energy in Tiny Drops of Early-Universe Matter
science.summary: Oxygen collisions at Brookhaven’s retired RHIC revealed that jets lose approximately 20% of their energy, indicating the presence of early-universe matter in small drops. STAR physicists recorded this phenomenon in 2021, demonstrating that even small nuclei can momentarily create a quark-gluon plasma. This finding provides insight into the behavior of high-energy particles and the conditions of the early universe.

science.title: Kutch soil lays new ground for studying Mars surface
science.summary: Scientists from PRL and IIT-Gandhinagar are studying natrojarosite found in Kutch, Gujarat, as a Mars soil analogue. This yellowish-brown soil, located near Mata no Madh, enhances spectral identification from rover and orbiter data. The research aims to provide insights into Mars' past climate, potentially improving our understanding of the planet's surface and geological history.

science.title: Who is Bibha Chowdhuri? Indian physicist who studied cosmic rays and had a star named in her honour
science.summary: Bibha Chowdhuri was a pioneering Indian physicist known for her research on cosmic rays. She was one of the first women in India to work in high-energy physics and published significant findings in the journal Nature. In recognition of her contributions, a star was named Bibha in her honor decades after her passing, celebrating her legacy in science.
